blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.
blocks.zh: DINO等共同识别预加训练的表示方式可以大幅度提高流量匹配模型的训练速度和质量,但它引入了第二个调试轨迹,需要精心设计的时间表. 我们提出一个更简单的方案:直接预测预先训练过的表示,然后以自己的预测作为模型的条件。 这样就不再需要第二个业务守则和任何针对代表的取消提名时间表,同时保留代表指导的好处。 我们的做法大大加快了速度,实现了以FID分数衡量的更好的发电质量。 在ImageNet上,它比先前的方法少2x的时空比潜在空间的艺术状态要好;在像素空间中,它比可比的先前方法改进了超过20%的FID. 这些结果支持一个简单的原则:不要欺骗你所能预测的东西。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing上公开查阅。

blocks.en: Pretrained representations should help a model generate better images, not strain it by learning one more diffusion trajectory! Yet recent flow matching methods that leverage pretrained representations, such as DINO , typically diffuse and denoise the representation alongside the image. In fact, a trend started by ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) and recently popularized by ( Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Baade et al., 2026 ) is to jointly denoise images and DINO embeddings, followed by ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Petsangourakis et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) that extend this with <cls> token, dual-stream or auxiliary networks. This joint co-denoising speeds up training compared to the standard denoising as the model can leverage the additional information of the frozen representations.
blocks.zh: 预设的表达方式应该有助于模型生成更好的图像,而不是通过学习再传播出一条轨迹来使其紧张! 然而,最近利用事先经过培训的表示方法(如DINO)的流量匹配方法,通常在图像的同时分散并去除表示。 事实上,由(Bao等人,2023;Xu等人,2023)开始的并最近被(Kouzelis等人,2025;Baade等人,2026)所普及的趋势是,将图像和DINO嵌入物联合曝光,随后是(Wu等人,2025;Pan等人,2026;Petsangourakis等人,2026;Lin等人,2026)。 与标准的去名相比,这种联合去名可以加快培训,因为模型可以利用被冻结的表述的额外信息。

blocks.en: However, in this work, we claim that this co-denoising comes with two paradoxes: First, the extra information introduced to guide the image generation problem is now completely hidden in the noise such that the model has to untangle the informative bits of that modality. Second, the learning problem is made artificially harder than it should be 1 1 1 It is still easier than not using the additional representation. because it consists of matching pairs of independent noise samples ( ϵ I , ϵ D \epsilon_{I},\epsilon_{D} from Fig. 1 , bottom left) to a coupled pair (image x x , DINO z = ϕ ⁡ ( x ) z=\phi(x) ) that does not require the extra noise since the link between the image and its representation is deterministic.
blocks.zh: 然而,在这部作品中,我们声称这种共同的贬义伴随着两个悖论: 首先,为引导图像生成问题而引入的额外信息现在完全被隐藏在噪音中,以至于模型必须解开该模式中的信息位. 第二,学习问题被人为地弄得比应该的11更难 仍比不使用额外代表更容易。 因为它包括匹配对独立噪声标本(  I,ε D\epsilon_{I},\epsilon_{D}从图一,左下方)到一对相接对(图像 x, DINO z = φ (x) z (x) =\ (x)),不需要额外的噪声,因为图像与其代表的关联是决定性的.

blocks.en:
In this work, we remove these paradoxes with one simple idea: pretrained representations should constrain generation, not become
another generation target. The pretrained representation is not an independent quantity that needs its own generative trajectory; it is a property of the image that the model can progressively infer as the image emerges. Our key idea is therefore simple: rather than denoising a second representation, we ask the model to predict the representation it needs ( Fig. 1 top right).
This keeps the search entirely in the image space, recovering the simple one-to-one mapping problem ( Fig. 1 bottom right) while benefiting from the guidance of the pretrained representation.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们用一个简单的想法去除这些悖论:预先训练过的表述应该制约生成,而不是成为
另一个世代的目标。 被预先训练的表示方式并不是需要自身基因轨迹的独立数量;而是模型随着图像的出现可以逐渐推断出的形象属性. 因此,我们的关键想法很简单:我们要求模型来预测它所需要的代表(图一右上方)。
这使得搜索完全保持在图像空间中,恢复了简单的一对一映射问题(图1正下方),同时受益于被预先训练的表示的指导.

blocks.en: This principle leads directly to our proposed DINO Forcing ( DF ), a method with two ouputs, one from image ODE and one for predicting DINO features that are used as self-conditioning. During training, a first look-ahead pass predicts the DINO representation associated with the current noisy image; a second pass conditions on this prediction to learn the image velocity. The predicted representation is aligned with a frozen DINO encoder ( Fig. 3 , right). At inference, the same prediction is simply rolled forward from one solver step to the next ( Fig. 4 ). Thus, the pretrained representation is produced by the generator itself and evolves together with the image.
blocks.zh: 这一原则直接导致了我们提议的DINO Forcing (DF),这种方法有两个自定义,一个来自图像ODE,一个用于预测用作自调节的DINO特征. 在训练期间,第一个外观-前方传球预测了与当前噪音图像相联的DINO代表;第二个传球条件,以学习图像速度. 预测的表示与被冻结的DINO编码器(图3,右)一致. 推论,同样的预测只是从一个解题步骤推向下一个步骤(图4)。 因此,预受训练的表示由生成器本身产生,并会与图像一起演化.

blocks.en: In latent space, DF reaches an FID of 2.47 after only 100 epochs, surpassing prior methods trained for substantially longer ( Fig. 2 , right). At the same training budget, our B model outperforms XL baseline models, showing that the gain does not come from scale. In pixel space, DF improves over Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) from 7.20 to 5.53 FID at comparable model size and training budget. These results support our claim that explicitly co-denoising is unnecessary: predicting the pretrained representation is not only simpler, but leads to substantially faster convergence.
blocks.zh: 在潜伏空间中,DF只经过了100个纪元之后就达到了2.47的FID,超过了以前经过长时间训练的方法(图2,右)。 在同一培训预算中,我们的B模型的绩效超过了XL基线模型,表明收益不是来自规模。 在像素空间中,DF比Latetnt Forcing(Baade等,2026年)改进从7.20到5.53FID,其模型规模和培训预算相当. 这些结果支持了我们的说法,即明确的共同定义是不必要的:预测预先训练过的表述不仅简单,而且导致更快的趋同。

blocks.en:
Our contrbutions are:
(1) we show that directly predicting DINO representations is sufficiently informative to guide generation, without needing to explicitly denoise it.
(2) we propose DINO Forcing : a schedule-free self-conditioning mechanism that predicts, rather than denoise, the pretrained representation used to guide generation.
(3) DF achieves strong performance in substantially fewer training epochs for both latent and pixel space flow matching frameworks.
blocks.zh:
我们的意见是:
(1) 我们表明,直接预测DINO表述信息足以指导生成,而不需要明确披露。
(2) 我们提议DINO Forcing : 一种无排程的自调节机制,它预测而不是去除用于引导生成的事先训练过的表示.
(3) DF在潜在和像素空间流量匹配框架的培训时代显著减少方面能实现强效.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) and flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) models are trained with denoising objectives that favour fine-grained, reconstruction-oriented representations over high-level semantic ones ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , which slows convergence: state-of-the-art generators typically need over 500 epochs DiT : Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; SiT : Ma et al., 2024 ; JiT : Li and He, 2026 ; fv-loss : Degeorge et al., 2026 ; TREAD : Krause et al., 2025 . Aligning internal features with external pretrained representations accelerates training REPA : Yu et al., 2025 ; iREPA : Singh et al., 2026a ; HASTE : Wang et al., 2025b ; REED : Wang et al., 2025a ; DDT : Wang et al., 2026 ; PixelDiT : Yu et al., 2026a ; PixelREPA : Shin et al., 2026 ; DeCo : Ma et al., 2026a ; PixelGen : Ma et al., 2026b . But at sampling time the model runs unguided: the signal lacks when it is most needed. A complementary line performs flow matching directly in a pre-aligned latent space RAE : Zheng et al., 2026 ; DINO-SAE : Chang et al., 2026 , so the representation is present throughout sampling. But this requires training a new decoder and architectural changes. A more comprehensive comparison is given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 传播(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年;Ho等,2020年)和流量匹配(Lipman等,2023年)模型都经过培训,具有有利于精细、以重建为导向的表述而非高层次语义表述的去名目标(Yu等,2025年),这减缓了趋同:最先进的发电机通常需要500多个时代。 DiT:皮布尔斯和谢,2023;SiT: Ma等,2024;JiT:Li and He,2026;fv-loss:: Degeorge等人,2026; TREAD : Krause等人,2025。 将内部特征与外部预先培训的表述相配合, Yu等人,2025年;iREPA: Singh等,2026a;HASTE:Wang等,2025b;REED:Wang等,2025a;DDT:Wang等,2026;PixelDIT:Yu等,2026a;PixelREPA:Shin等,2026;DeCo:Ma等,2026a;PixelGen:Ma等,2026b。 但是在取样时,模型运行时没有制导:信号缺乏最需要的时候. 辅助行在预对齐的潜在空间 RAE 中直接进行相配: 郑等,2026; DINO-SAE : Chang等,2026年,因此在整个采样过程中都存在代表. 但这需要训练出新的解码器和建筑改变. 附录D提供了更全面的比较。

blocks.en:
Jointly denoising multiple modalities ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) offers an appealing alternative: it implicitly aligns pretrained representations while preserving them throughout generation, including at inference. This accelerates training convergence, both in a latent ReDi : Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; CoReDi : Kouzelis et al., 2026 ; REG : Wu et al., 2025 ; SFD : Pan et al., 2026 ; REGLUE : Petsangourakis et al., 2026 and directly in pixel space LatentForcing : Baade et al., 2026 ; V-Co : Lin et al., 2026 ; CoReDi : Kouzelis et al., 2026 . The cost is a second noise scheduler that must be hand-crafted: SFD ( Pan et al., 2026 ) and LatentForcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) both find that denoising the representation to a low noise level before starting the image yields the fastest convergence, a schedule that likely needs re-tuning for different modalities.
A more direct approach is to condition the generator on pretrained representations rather than denoise them from scratch RCG : Li et al., 2024 ; PixelDiT2 : Yu et al., 2026b . Inspired by self-conditioning ( Jabri et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , we condition the model on its own predicted representation at each denoising step. Unlike prior self-conditioning work, we align these predictions with an external pretrained feature space, i.e. DINO . The representation is then available throughout generation with no handcrafted schedule, while still training faster.
blocks.zh:
联合谴责多种方式(Bao等,2023;Xu等,2023)提供了一个具有吸引力的替代办法:它含蓄地协调预先训练过的表述,同时在一代人中保留这些表述,包括推论。 这加速了培训的趋同,无论是在潜入的ReDi 中都是如此:Kouzelis等人,2025年;CoReDi : Kouzelis等人,2026年;REG:Wu等人,2025年;SFD:: Pan等, 2026; REGLUE: Petsangourakis等, 2026并直接以像素空间 LatetForcing : Baade等,2026;V-Co:Lin等,2026;CoReDi:Kouzelis等,2026. 成本是需要手工制作的第二个噪音调度器: SFD (Pan等, 2026年)和LatetForcing (Baade等, 2026年)都发现,在开始图像之前去诺到低噪音水平的表示产生最快的趋同,这个调度可能需要对不同的模式进行再调整.
更直接的办法是让生成者接受预先训练的表述, Li等, 2024; PixelDiT2 : Yu等, 2026b. 受自理所启发(Jabri等,2023;Chen等,2023),我们以每个去诺步骤的预言代表为模型的条件. 与之前的自建工作不同,我们将这些预测与外部的预训特征空间相配合,即DINO. 然后,在整个一代人中都有这种表述,没有手工制作的时间表,同时培训速度仍然更快。

blocks.zh: 3 DINO-强制操作

blocks.en: Here, we first give an overview of DF , then detail its two-pass training procedure ( Section 3.1 ), and how image and representation tokens are fused, and finally its sampling ( Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在此,我们首先概述DF,然后详细介绍其双通训练程序(第3.1节),以及图像和表示符号是如何接合的,最后是取样(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: DINO-Forcing ( DF ) generates images by relying on a simple idea: rather than denoising a separate pretrained representation in parallel, it predicts the pretrained representation it needs (i.e. DINO ) and conditions itself on that prediction throughout generation.
blocks.zh: DINO-Forcing (DF)通过依赖一个简单的想法来生成图像:它不是同时去除一个单独的事先训练过的表示,而是预测自己需要的事先训练过的表示(即DINO),以及整个世代对该预测的条件本身.

blocks.en: Concretely, at each training step, DF produces a look-ahead estimate of the pretrained representation, z ^ \hat{z} , associated with the image, x x , being denoised (see Fig. 3 ; Pass-1). Then, it uses that estimate as a conditioning signal for a forward-backward update pass (see Fig. 3 ; Pass-2). At sampling time, these DINO representations are predicted and are rolled out across denoising steps, providing a continuously updated, model-generated guide (see Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 具体来说,DF在每个训练步骤上都会对预训表现进行外观前期估计,z ^\ hat{z},与图像相关,xxxx被去名化(见图3;Pass-1). 然后,它利用这一估计作为前向后向更新通关(见图3;Pass-2)的调节信号. 在取样时,这些DINO表示方式是预测的,并在整个降意步骤中展开,提供不断更新的模型生成的指南(见图4)。

blocks.en: 4 Prediction vs co-denoising
blocks.zh: 4 预测与共同定义

blocks.en: As motivated in Section 2 , most recent image generation approaches either remove pretrained representation information at inference time, or require extra decoders and hand-crafted denoising schedules to preserve it.
blocks.zh: 正如第2节所激发的那样,最近的图像生成方法要么在推论时间删除事先训练过的表示信息,要么需要额外的解码器和手工解码时间表来保存.

blocks.en:
We focus on co-denoising, as it keeps an estimate of the pretrained representation during the denoising process, and try to directly address the limitations of these approaches.
Co-denoising methods ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Baade et al., 2026 ) come with notable performance gains, mainly due to sharing one network between two tasks: denoising the image x x and denoising an additional pretrained representation ϕ ⁡ ( x ) \phi(x) , which can be text as in ( Bao et al., 2023 ) or DINOv2 as in ( Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Baade et al., 2026 ) . Even though this results in faster convergence than image-only denoising baselines, it requires an additional ODE trajectory for the pretrained representations (and thereby handcrafted schedules).
blocks.zh:
我们侧重于共同认定,因为它在取消提名过程中对事先训练过的代表作出估计,并试图直接解决这些办法的局限性。
共同识别方法(Bao等人,2023年;Kouzelis等人,2025年;Baade等人,2026年)取得了显著的绩效收益,这主要是由于在两个任务之间共用一个网络:去除图像xx和去除额外经过预先培训的XX (x)\phi (x),其文本可以如(Bao等人,2023年)或DNOv2(Kouzelis等人,2025年;Baade等人,2026年). 尽管这导致比仅以图像表示的基线更快的趋同,但对于预先训练过的表示(从而需要手工制作的时间表),还需要额外的ODE轨迹.

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet class-conditional benchmark, in both latent space ( Section 5.1 ) and pixel space ( Section 5.2 ). We then analyse what the representation prediction branch learns by inverting its predictions back to images ( Section 5.3 ), and study generation driven by the predicted features alone ( Section 5.4 ). We ablate the components of our method in Section 5.5 . Qualitative samples are shown in Fig. 2 left, with more uncurated samples in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们在ImageNet类条件基准上,在潜在空间(第5.1节)和像素空间(第5.2节)上评价我们的方法。 然后,我们分析表述预测处通过将预测反向图像(第5.3节)而学到的知识,并研究仅由预测特征驱动的生成情况(第5.4节)。 我们放弃了5.5节中的方法 图2列出了定性样本,附录E列出了更多未经检验的样本。

blocks.en: We compare DF against latent space state-of-the-art methods using the ADM ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) evaluation suite and its reference statistics. We generate 50K samples and report Fréchet Inception Distance ( FID ) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , Inception Score ( IS ) ( Salimans et al., 2016 ) , Precision ( P ) and Recall ( R ) ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2019 ) . For pixel space, we report FID against the JiT reference statistics. Since JiT does not release the images needed for the remaining metrics, IS , P and R are computed with the ADM suite.
blocks.zh: 我们利用ADM(Dhariwal和Nichol, 2021年)评价套件及其参考统计数据将DF与潜在的空间最新方法进行比较。 我们生成50K样本,并报告Fréchet Inception District(FID)(Heusel等,2017年),Inception Score(IS)(Salimans等,2016年),P精度(P)和Recall(R)(Kynkäänniemi等,2019年). 对于像素空间,我们对照JiT参考统计报告FID. 由于JiT不发布剩余度量衡所需的图像,IS,P和R用ADM套件来计算.

blocks.en: 5.1 Latent Space Setting
blocks.zh: 5.1 后空格设置

blocks.en: In the latent space setting, we follow the implementations of SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) with the only exception of having extra input and output projections for the pretrained representation features. We train our model in the sd-vae-ft-ema ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) latent space. We follow prior works ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Baade et al., 2026 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025 ) and use DINOv2-B ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) features. We weight our frozen representation loss ( λ \lambda in Eq. 1 ) with a value of 0.5 0.5 , similar to prior work ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . Consistent with previous works ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , we use the Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) optimizer without any weight decay and a constant learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1e{-4} . In contrast to previous methods, we sample using a simple Euler ODE solver in 50 steps instead of using SDE solvers. We train using the null condition 10% of the time for classifier-free guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2021 ) . For the pretrained representation condition, 10% of the time we do optimization on just the 1st forward pass to make the model learn a better prediction when the conditions are all zeros. We also set the pretrained representation prediction condition to the original DINOv2 features 5% of the time to make the model more stable when it has already reached the required feature. For XL models, we use a dropout of 0.1 on the middle third of the SiT blocks (both for attention and the feedforward layers). Implementation details are given in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 在潜在的空间环境中,我们跟踪SiT(Ma等,2024年)的实施,唯一的例外是,对预先训练的表示特性有额外的投入和产出预测。 我们训练我们的模型 在sd-vae-ft-ema(Rombach等,2022年)潜入空间。 我们跟踪以往的作品(Yu等人,2025年;Baade等人,2026年;Kouzelis等人,2025年),并使用DINov2-B(Oquab等人,2024年)特征. 我们用0.5.0.5的数值来衡量我们冻结的表示损失(在Eq. 1中),与以前的工作(Yu等,2025年)。 与之前的作品相符合(Ma等,2024年),我们使用亚当(Kingma和Ba,2014年)优化器而没有任何重量衰减,并恒定学习率为1e-4 1e{4}. 与前作不同,我们用简单的Euler ODE解析器在50个步骤中进行取样,而不是使用SDE解析器. 我们使用无效的10%时间来进行无分级指导(Ho and Salimans, 2021). 对于预先训练的表征条件, 10%的时间,我们做优化 仅仅在第一个前传,使模型 学习更好的预测 当条件都是零。 我们还将预设的表示预测条件设定为原DINOv2的特征5%,以便在模型已经达到需要的特征时使其更加稳定. 对于XL模型,我们在SiT区块的中间三分之一使用0.1的退出(既用于注意也用于向上分层). 执行情况详见表8。

blocks.en: When compared with state-of-the-art works at a similar parameter count ( Figure 2 ), DF reaches 2.61 at 80 epochs, better than or on par with methods trained substantially longer: REPA at 800 epochs (5.78), CoReDi at 400 epochs (3.30), REG at 200 epochs (2.70) and REGLUE at 200 epochs (2.50). When further trained for 20 more epochs DF shows a 2 × 2\times reduction in training budget over REGLUE (see Table 2 ), the previous best method at a comparable parameter count in the same latent space: 2.47 2.47 after 100 epochs against 2.50 2.50 after 200 epochs. We must note that the excellent work, TREAD ( Krause et al., 2025 ) , remains competitive without using external pretrained model. Since the two approaches are orthogonal, combining DF with TREAD should yield further gains.

blocks.en: Like RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , we found guidance non-trivial to implement for our latent space model. As such, following RAE we also use Autoguidance ( Karras et al., 2024 ) and use an L model’s checkpoint at 150K steps to act as the weaker model. This leads to a guided FID score of 2.35 (see Table 2 ;). It reflects an improvement; however its not as drastic as prior works, which are trained for at least 2 × \times more than our setup. We agree that the guided scores are still a bit underwhelming and more work must be done to improve on it. Interesting ideas like Internal Guidance ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) with intermediate outputs can be an interesting avenue to explore to improve upon the guidance, and we leave this as future work to further improve upon our core idea.

blocks.en: 5.2 Pixel Space Setting
blocks.zh: 5.2 像素空间设置

blocks.en: For pixel space, we closely follow the implementations of JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) and we use DINOv2-B as the pretrained representation. We observe that v v -loss in pixel-space is 13 × ~13\times lower than in latent space so we lower λ = 0.03 \lambda=0.03 in Eq. 1 . We use Adam optimizer without any weight decay, with a constant learning rate of 2 ​ e − 4 2e-4 after a warmup for 5 epochs. For pixel space experiments, we follow Heun Sampler ( Heun and others, 1900 ) with 50 sampling steps. Similar to the latent space setting, we use the null condition 10% of the training, optimize on the first forward pass 10% of the training, use the original DINOv2-B features for 5% of the training, and we use a dropout rate of 0.1 0.1 for our bigger XL models. Additional implementation details are further provided in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 对于像素空间,我们密切关注JiT(Li and He, 2026)的实现,我们使用DINOv2-B作为预先训练的表示. 我们观测到 v - 损失在像素- 空间 13 × ~ 13\ 时间比在潜在空间 低, 因此我们降低 = 0.03\ lambda= 0.03 在 Eq. 1 中。 我们使用亚当优化器而没有任何重量衰减,在5个纪元的热身后,持续学习率为2 e - 4 2e-4. 对于像素空间实验,我们跟随"恒生样本"(Heun等,1900年)有50个采样步骤. 与潜在空间设置类似,我们使用10%训练的无效条件,优化了10%训练的首个前行通道,使用5%训练的原始DINOv2-B特性,我们使用0.10.1的辍学率来进行更大的XL模型. 表8进一步提供了其他执行细节。

blocks.en: The improvements observed with SiT carry over to JiT (see Table 1 ): all model sizes improve with XL reaching an unguided FID of 5.45 5.45 . We compare DF againt Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) in Table 3 . At 200 epochs, DF reaches 5.53 5.53 with an L-sized model, against 7.20 7.20 . We attribute this gap to how the pretrained representation signal is produced: Latent Forcing commits to a single schedule, fixed at training time and shared across the dataset, that dictates when pretrained representation information is revealed relative to pixels. DF instead derives the conditioning from the sample being generated, so the pretrained representation signal adapts to each trajectory rather than following a common ordering.
blocks.zh: 观测到的与SiT相接的改进转移到了JiT(见表1):所有型号尺寸都有所改进,XL达到了无制导FID为5.45 5.45. 我们在表3中再次比较了Lateant Forcing(Baade等人,2026年)。 在200个纪元时,DF达到5.53 5.53,采用L级模型,而7.20 7.20. 我们将此差距归因于如何产生预先训练的表示信号: Latett Forcing承诺采用单一的时间表,在培训时固定,并在数据集之间共享,这决定了何时相对于像素显示预先训练过的表示信息. DF取而代之的是从所生成的样本中取出条件,因此预受训练的表示信号适应了每个轨迹,而不是遵循共同的指令.

blocks.en: Prior co-denoising works in pixel space, like Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , require a split scheme, applying AutoGuidance ( Karras et al., 2024 ) on pixel timesteps and CFG interval ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2024 ) on representation timesteps, because the two modalities advance on separate schedules. Having a single trajectory, we need no such split: the default interval guidance setting works well without method-specific tuning ( Table 3 ). At L size we reach 2.26, surpassing Latent Forcing (2.48) as well as PixelDiT-2 (2.35). At XL size we reach 2.13, against 2.89 for JiT-XL under the same setting. We remain behind PixelGen-XL , which reaches 1.83 at 160 epochs in a similar parameter range; we attribute this to its use of frozen VGG ( Simonyan and Zisserman, 2014 ) supervision alongside DINO , and leave the combination of the two signals to future work.
blocks.zh: 先前在像素空间中的同分辨工作,如Latent Forcing(Baade等,2026年),需要分解方案,在像素时序和CFG间隔(Kynkäänniemi等,2024年)上应用AutoGuidance(Karras等,2024年),因为两种方式在不同的时刻表上推进. 具有单一的轨迹,我们不需要这种分出:默认间隔制导在不进行特定方法的调取的情况下运作良好(表3)。 在L体积上,我们达到2.26,超过了Latent Forcing(2.48)和PixelDiT-2(2.35). 在XL大小时,我们达到2.13,而在同一情况下,JiT-XL则为2.89。 我们一直落后于PixelGen-XL,它以相近的参数范围在160个世纪达到1.83;我们将此归因于它使用被冻结的VGG(Simonyan和Zisserman,2014年)与DINO同时监督,并将两个信号的组合留给了未来的工作.

blocks.en: 5.3 DINO inversion
blocks.zh: 5.3 DINO倒置

blocks.en: Our method assumes the branch produces something semantically meaningful, not only an arbitrary code that happens to help the velocity prediction. We visualise the PCA of the predicted features across the trajectory in Fig. 5 and Fig. 14 ): their structures are spatially coherent and separates object from background before the image itself is resolved, and it sharpens as denoising progresses.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法假设树枝产生一些有目的的东西, 不仅仅是一种任意的代码, 它碰巧帮助速度预测。 我们在图5和图14中将预测的地物描绘成PA:它们的结构在空间上是相通的,在图像本身解决之前就将物体与背景相分离,随着去声的进步而变尖.

blocks.en: Furthermore, as the representation-conditioning branch processes representation features, we can bypass the prediction at inference and feed real DINOv2 features instead. This turns the model into a DINOv2 inverter: given the features of an image and a null class, it reconstructs the image itself. Figure 6 shows reconstructions from inverted DINOv2 . Table 5 reports SSIM and PSNR for SiT (16.86 dB / 0.48 SSIM) and JiT (14.33 dB / 0.44 SSIM), showing that the interaction of the DINOv2 condition provides very good local information for reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 此外,作为代表-调节分支处理代表特征,我们可以绕过推论的预测,输入真正的DINOv2特征。 这使得模型变成了DINov2倒置:鉴于一幅图像和一副无类的特征,它重建了图像本身. 图6显示由倒转的DINOv2进行的重建。 表5报告了SiT(16.86分贝/0.48分贝)和JiT(14.33分贝/0.44分贝)的SSIM和PSNR,表明DINov2条件的相互作用为重建提供了非常好的地方信息.

blocks.en: 5.4 Generation without class condition
blocks.zh: 5.4 无等级条件的生成

blocks.en: The predicted DINOv2 from the representation-conditioning branch can be seen as a standalone condition. To test this, we train with the class token set to null for the entire run, so the model has no conditioning signal other than the one it predicts for itself. We compare this setup with unconditional SiT and JiT and with Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) in Table 6 . In latent space, DF reaches an FID of 9.14 9.14 against 49.51 49.51 for SiT-L/2 . In pixel space it reaches 15.19 15.19 , against 53.97 53.97 for JiT-L/16 and 20.44 20.44 for Latent Forcing . This setting isolates the main difference with Latent Forcing : when all of the conditioning comes from the pretrained representation branch, predicting it outperforms denoising it on a fixed schedule.
blocks.zh: 来自代表-空调分支的预测的DINOv2可以看作是一个独立的条件. 为了测试这一点,我们用设定的类代号来训练整个跑道的无效,所以该型号除了它为自己预言的外,没有其他的调节信号. 我们把这一设置与无条件的SiT和JiT以及Latent Forcing(Baade等人,2026年)相比较,见表6。 在潜在空间中,DF的FID为9.14 9.14,SiT-L/2为49.51 49.51。 在像素空间中,它达到15.19 15.19, 而JiT-L/16是53.97,Latent Forcing是20.44 20.44。 这种设置隔离了与Latetnt Forcing的主要区别 : 当所有条件来自被预先训练的表示分支时,预测它的表现超过在固定的日程上去命名它.

blocks.zh: 5.5 违约

blocks.en: The improvement from DF could come from the conditioning mechanism, or from the pretrained representation content of the target. To separate the two, we train four variants with identical architectures that differ only in what the representation branch is asked to predict ( Table 7 ). DF - ∅ \emptyset leaves the predicted features unsupervised. DF -image supervises the branch to predict the image itself, a well-defined but low-level target. DF - MAE uses Masked Autoencoder ( MAE-B ) ( He et al., 2022 ) features, a strong reconstruction-based self-supervised target. DF - DINO supervision uses DINOv2 features, as in our full method. The conditioning mechanism helps on its own: without any supervision, FID drops from 18.80 18.80 to 12.96 12.96 . Supervising with the raw image adds little ( 11.93 11.93 ). So a reconstruction target is not what drives the gain. MAE features show much broader improvement (more than a 10-point improvement over baseline). However, with DINOv2 features, FID reaches 3.04 3.04 , 6 × 6\times below the baseline. The conditioning mechanism is necessary but not sufficient; the pretrained representation content of the target is what produces most of the improvement.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced DINO-Forcing , a simple alternative to co-denoising pretrained representations in flow-matching models. Instead of assigning the representation its own noisy trajectory, we predict it from the current image state and immediately reuse it as conditioning. This removes the second ODE and representation-specific denoising schedule, while preserving the benefits of representation guidance.
Despite its simplicity, this change substantially improves both convergence and generation quality, surpassing methods trained for substantially longer both in latent and pixel space. More broadly, our results suggest that auxiliary representations need not always be generated alongside the primary modality: when they can be inferred from the evolving sample, prediction may be enough.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了DINO-Forcing, 一种简单的替代方法, 我们没有指定它自己的吵闹的轨迹,而是从目前的图像状态来预测它,并立即重新使用它作为条件。 这删除了第二个代言人和代表专用代言时间表,同时保留了代表指导的好处。
这一变化尽管简单,但大大提高了聚合和生成质量,超过了在潜在和像素空间中经过长时间培训的方法。 更广泛地说,我们的结果表明,辅助表述不一定总是与主要模式一起产生的:当从不断演变的样本中推断出来时,预测可能就足够了。

blocks.en: Appendix B Explanation behind our fusing Image and Frozen Representations mechanism
blocks.zh: 附录B 引信图像和冷冻代表机制背后的解释

blocks.en: One particularly interesting question that arises from Figure 3 is how we merge the image and the frozen representations. Given we use DiT based transformer architecture, we use same number of tokens as in the image. As such, any token-wise merge operation suffices. However, for our experiments, we fuse our image and representation tokens by concatenating them via the channel dimension. Given an image (or its feature), x x , we extract patch tokens of shape (B,T,D) via standard patchification. We set our starting representation token dimension to (B,T,D’) matching the dimension of frozen pretrained encoder (e.g., DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) ). The two token sequences are thereafter spatially aligned and concatenated along the channel dimension, yielding a fused representation of shape (B,T,D+D’) , which is then projected to the transformer’s hidden dimension via a lightweight linear layer. This keeps the token count identical to a standard image-only model and requires no spatial resampling, making it directly compatible with existing flow matching architectures. Our fusion strategy is similar in spirit to concurrent work ( Kouzelis et al., 2025 ) , but simpler by virtue of requiring no upsampling. There are many other ways we can fuse the tokens, and we urge the readers to follow the excellent V-Co ( Lin et al., 2026 ) paper, which does a deep dive into different fusion techniques. Here, we stick to the channel concatenation strategy just for proper comparison and leave the exploration of other types of fusion strategies for future work.

blocks.en: Appendix D Extended related work
blocks.zh: 附录D 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) and flow matching models ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) are trained with denoising objectives that predominantly encourage fine-grained, reconstruction-oriented internal representations rather than high-level semantic ones ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . This lack of semantic structure slows training convergence with state-of-the-art image generation models typically requiring over 500 training epochs to reach strong performance DiT : Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; SiT : Ma et al., 2024 ; JiT : Li and He, 2026 ; f ​ v fv -loss : Degeorge et al., 2026 ; TREAD : Krause et al., 2025 . Recent works REPA : Yu et al., 2025 ; iREPA : Singh et al., 2026a ; HASTE : Wang et al., 2025b ; REED : Wang et al., 2025a ; DDT : Wang et al., 2026 ; PixelDiT : Yu et al., 2026a ; PixelREPA : Shin et al., 2026 ; DeCo : Ma et al., 2026a ; PixelGen : Ma et al., 2026b have shown that explicitly aligning a model’s internal features with external pretrained representations substantially accelerates convergence. A complementary line of work takes this further by performing flow matching directly in a pre-aligned representation latent space RAE : Zheng et al., 2026 ; RAEv2 : Singh et al., 2026b ; DINO-SAE : Chang et al., 2026 , yielding additional convergence speedups.
Despite their promise, both approaches have their own limitations when applied to image generation. Feature alignment methods inject pretrained information only during training; at sampling time, the model operates without any explicit guidance, effectively discarding the alignment signal precisely when it is needed. Pre-aligned latent approaches sidestep this by embedding pretrained information into the generation space itself, but at the cost of training a new decoder and introducing non-trivial architectural modifications. A natural middle ground is to jointly denoise both pretrained representation and image, which we discuss next.
blocks.zh:
传播模型(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年;Ho等,2020年)和流相匹配模型(Lipman等,2023年)接受了去名化目标培训,主要鼓励精细、以重建为导向的内部表述,而不是高层次的语义表述(Yu等,2025年)。 这种语义结构的缺乏减缓了培训与最先进的图像生成模型的趋同,通常需要500多个培训时代才能达到强效DiT: Peebles and Xie, 2023;SiT: Ma等人, 2024; JiT : Li and He, 2026; f v fv-loss: Degeorge等, 2026; TREAD: Krause等, 2025。 近期著作REPA:Yu等,2025;iREPA:Singh等,2026a;HASTE:Wang等,2025b;REED:Wang等,2025a;DDT:Wang等,2026;PixelDIT:Yu等,2026a;PixelREPA:Shin等,2026;DeCo:Ma等,2026a;PixelGen:Ma等,2026b表明,将一个模型的内部特征与外部预先紧张的表述明确相配合,大大地加速了趋同。 通过在预相配对的空间中进行流动直接匹配,一个互补的工作路线进一步推进了这项工作: 郑等,2026;RAEv2: Singh等,2026b;DINO-SAE:: 昌等,2026年,产生额外的汇合速度.
这两种方法尽管有承诺,但在适用于图像生成时都有自己的局限性。 特性校正方法仅在培训期间注入事先训练过的信息;在取样时,该模型在操作时没有任何明确的指导,在需要时就有效地抛弃了校正信号. 预先对接的潜在方法通过将事先训练过的信息嵌入生成空间本身而避免了这种情况,但代价是培训新的解码器和引入非三角结构的修改。 一个自然的中间点是共同将预先训练过的能见度和形象都暴露出来,我们接下来讨论这个问题。

blocks.en:
Jointly denoising multiple modalities ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) offers an appealing alternative: it implicitly aligns pretrained representations while preserving them throughout the entire generation process, including at inference. Applied to image generation, this strategy accelerates training convergence, training both in a latent image feature space ReDi : Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; CoReDi : Kouzelis et al., 2026 ; REG : Wu et al., 2025 ; SFD : Pan et al., 2026 REGLUE : Petsangourakis et al., 2026 or directly in pixel space LatentForcing : Baade et al., 2026 ; V-Co : Lin et al., 2026 ; CoReDi : Kouzelis et al., 2026 .
However, co-denoising introduces its own complexity: the optimal noise schedule for the pretrained representation is non-trivial to determine and must be carefully hand-crafted. For instance, SFD ( Pan et al., 2026 ) and LatentForcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) found that denoising the pretrained representation branch (e.g., DINO features) to a low noise level before beginning image denoising yields the best convergence speed, a schedule that likely needs to be re-tuned for different modalities, making the approach brittle to apply in general.
blocks.zh:
联合宣布多种方式(Bao等,2023;Xu等,2023)提供了一个有吸引力的替代办法:它含蓄地协调预先训练过的表述,同时在整个一代人的过程中保留这些表述,包括推论。 运用于图像生成的策略加速了培训的趋同, Kouzelis等,2025年;CoReDi:Kouzelis等,2026年;REG:Wu等,2025年;SFD: Pan等,2026 REGLUE : Petsangourakis等,2026年或直接在像素空间LatetForcing: Baade等,2026;V-Co:Lin等,2026;CoReDi:Kouzelis等,2026.
然而,同分辨引入了自身的复杂性:预受考验的表示方式的最佳噪声表是非三角来决定,必须小心地手工制作. 例如,SFD(Pan等,2026年)和LatetForcing(Baade等,2026年)发现,在开始图像去Noing之前,将事先训练过的表示分支(如DINO特征)去Noing到低噪音水平,产生最佳的汇合速度,这个时刻表可能需要重新调整不同的模式,使方法变得简洁而笼统地适用.

blocks.en:
The limitations above share a common structure: they all stem from either the absence of pretrained information during image generation, or the need for additional models and carefully designed schedules to introduce it. One principled way to address this is to condition the image generation model directly on pretrained representations, bypassing the need to denoise them from scratch RCG : Li et al., 2024 ; PixelDiT2 : Yu et al., 2026b . Inspired by self-conditioning techniques ( Jabri et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , we propose to condition the model on its own predicted representation at each denoising step. Crucially, unlike prior self-conditioning works, we explicitly make these predicted self-conditions to align with an external pretrained feature space, encouraging the model to predict its own representation in a meaningful, structured sense.
This design simultaneously resolves the key failure modes of existing approaches: pretrained information is available throughout image generation without requiring a separate decoder, no architectural modifications, or handcrafted denoising schedules, while still achieving faster training convergence.
blocks.zh:
上述限制有一个共同的结构:它们都来自在图像生成过程中没有经过预先训练的信息,或者需要额外的模型和精心设计的时间表来引入. 一个原则性的方法是将图像生成模型直接附加在预先训练过的表示上, Li等, 2024; PixelDiT2 : Yu等, 2026b. 在自建技术的启发下(Jabri等,2023;Chen等,2023),我们提议在每一个去名步骤上将模型以自己预测的表示作为条件. 关键是,与之前的自建工程不同,我们明确提出这些预想的自建条件,以配合外部预先训练的地物空间,鼓励模型在有意义的,有条理的意义上预测自己的表现.
这种设计同时解决了现有方法的关键故障模式:在图像生成过程中可以提供预先训练过的信息,而不需要单独的解码器,不进行建筑修饰,或手动解码时间表,同时仍然能更快地实现培训的趋同.
